note: The raw reports record the Git HEAD at measurement time; source file hashes identify the then-uncommitted implementation and were verified against implementation_commit. Runs were sequential on the same machine.

baseline.protocol: Fresh process, adapter corpus of 10000 records, 24 warm queries, forced GC at process beforeExit after benchmark cleanup; cache/index remain reachable. Separate from latency sample runs.

baseline_adapter.label: Synthetic retrieval latency; not a coding utility or SOTA evaluation
baseline_adapter.protocol: In-process public search API, including filesystem discovery/validation, parsing, ranking, and passage generation. One cold query then a fixed mixed query cycle. OS file cache is not flushed. RSS is process-wide. Sources are synthetic. File hashes identify the measured implementation even if the checkout has uncommitted edits.

limitations: Fixed synthetic mixed-query cycle with 120 warm samples per compared corpus.
In-process API timings, not MCP round-trip or completed coding tasks.
No previous-candidate baseline at 10000 canonical records.
Cold runs do not flush the OS file cache.
Process-local index uses additional RAM; not a disk-backed FTS index.
